cases.prompt: Use this procedure for a bounded real task: Design a recurring workflow for human, deterministic automation, and optional agent work by modeling triggers, state, decisions, authority, checkpoints, failures, and observability. Use before automating a repeated operational loop.
sourceAnchors: Model a recurring loop before choosing automation. Assign deterministic work to code, judgment to an agent only where bounded, and authority-sensitive decisions to a human. Scheduling is optional and never implied.
